## Type of change

- [ ] `feat:` new feature
- [ ] `fix:` bug fix

## Bump

<!-- Pick ONE. It drives the next SemVer release. -->
- [ ] `#major` — breaking change
- [ ] `#minor` — new backward-compatible feature
- [ ] `#patch` — fix, refactor, docs
- [ ] `#none` — no release (CI, internal docs)

## Testing

- [ ] Tests added or updated for the changed behavior
- [ ] CI is green

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`type: description`, optional `[TICKET]` prefix)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated, if the repository keeps one
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or internal hostnames in code, logs or this description
